docs: Shared compiler settings. Every workspace package extends this and adds only its
own paths, so a strictness setting is changed in one place or not at all.
The strictness here is not decoration. packages/core computes character spans into
normalized text and is the single grammar shared by the device, the PWA and Node
Lambdas (ADR-001). An off-by-one or an undefined that only appears on one engine is
exactly the class of bug the type system should be catching for free.
